sparse_region_selected: Workspace state is not one object but a compatible family of local typed relations whose global realizability is compiled from topology.
alienness: The global workspace is treated as an existence problem over overlapping local semantic sections rather than as one privileged broadcast payload. This is a mechanism-level departure from the current object-centric workspace representation, even though its mathematical ingredients have strong prior art.
anti_hype: Radical for the current Frank representation does not imply mathematical novelty or world-first status.
